What are the key indicators of food insecurity in crisis situations?

Key indicators include: 1) Acute malnutrition rates (wasting) especially in children under 5, 2) Crude mortality rate exceeding 1 death per 10,000 people per day, 3) Access to food (availability, physical access, economic access), 4) Food consumption patterns and dietary diversity, 5) Livelihood coping strategies (selling assets, reducing meals), and 6) Hazards and vulnerabilities (conflict, displacement, market disruption).
